intro: Blood Tithe is a quest initiated by Alvarion Windfield, an ailing Skyborne farmer seeking aid in the settlement of Valanaar. Desperate to protect his livelihood, he recruits adventurers to travel west to his lowland orchard and assist his wife, Aamelia.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.
Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
